cappelli.original_work: Adriano Cappelli, Lexicon Abbreviaturarum, second edition, Leipzig, 1928

rights.statement: Ad fontes states that the images and information derive from Cappelli's Lexicon, are in the public domain, and may be reused without restriction.

cappelli.data_note: Crowdsourced transcription with crowd and expert quality control; Ad fontes cautions that occasional errors may remain and that its download is generated from the most recent data.

cappelli_latin_xiv_xv.selection: language equals latin (case-insensitive), and the period point or range intersects century XIV or XV
cappelli_latin_xiv_xv.notation_note: visible removes square-bracketed components from Cappelli's characters field. marked_components preserves their content. No claim is made that those components are omitted plaintext.

licensed_chunk_summary.method: Case-insensitive literal substring match within Cappelli's transcription/solution field. Counts license a chunk as part of an attested solution, not necessarily as the omitted span.
